description: TVibe FILTER is a Solana token signal API built for AI agents. One call returns a verdict PASS / REVIEW / SKIP with reasons and sell cost. Track record: OK 24.6% bad, Caution 67.9%, Avoid 92.9%. Resolved 1,955 verdicts. Heuristic signals only. Not financial advice.

endpoints.description: Get verdict for one token. Query: ?mint=<Solana mint>
Full verdict with holder quality, security, sell cost.
Explain verdict flag by flag, English or Vietnamese.
Public track record: resolved, pending, bad rates.
MCP server for Claude, Cursor, any MCP client. Tools: get_token_signal, check_token_risk, check_tokens_batch, check_exit, get_track_record.

honest_limits: Free host can sleep. If you get 503, retry after a few seconds.
Verdicts are heuristics, not a security audit and not financial advice.
Only tokens that are checked get measured, so track record is not a random sample.
Data from DexScreener, Solana RPC, RugCheck, Jupiter — can be late or wrong.
